hero.note: 3D renders and video based on the design
hero.lead: Stroll the red-brick cowboy street, step into the saloon, then wander through the stables and riding ring, all from your screen. Drag to look around, zoom into every detail, or watch the two-minute nineteen-second walkthrough.

explorer.title: Walk the Cowboy Street With Your Own Eyes
explorer.description: Pick a stop on the route, drag to move around the scene, and zoom in until you can see the grain of the timber. Every stop opens full screen.
explorer.hint: Double-click to zoom, drag to move around
explorer.hintTouch: Double-tap to zoom, swipe to change scene
explorer.disclaimer: Images are 3D renders based on the design; final details may differ slightly once completed.

aerial.title: Bird's-Eye View
aerial.subtitle: The whole ranch at a glance
aerial.text: A red-brick street runs straight from the timber gate to the heart of the ranch, lined with plank-walled buildings, a windmill and the steel-arched riding arena, all stretching toward the distant mountains.

entrance.title: Main Entrance
entrance.subtitle: Step into the Wild West
entrance.text: A rough-hewn timber gate carrying the Bách Mã Viên sign, a white picket fence, cacti and a windmill welcome you before the red-brick street into Cowboy Town.

welcome.title: Welcome Station
welcome.subtitle: Guest reception
welcome.text: A plank-walled house with a deep porch, warm string lights and a service counter. Your first stop to check in and get oriented before the journey begins.

archery.title: Bounty Hunter Archery
archery.subtitle: Bounty-hunter archery
archery.text: A two-storey building in classic saloon style, with a covered outdoor shooting lane and an indoor range divided into lanes A to F.

photoZone.title: Cowboy Town Photo Zone
photoZone.subtitle: Cowboy Town photo spot
photoZone.text: A classic timber facade with a wagon, barrels, a coiled lasso and a cowhide rug: a Western film set where you strike your own pose.

souvenirs.title: Souvenirs & Shopping
souvenirs.subtitle: Gifts and keepsakes
souvenirs.text: A timber-porch shop with large glass windows, right beside the café. A place to pick out something to take home after your visit.

costume.title: Costume Rental
costume.subtitle: Cowboy outfit rental
costume.text: A warm fitting room with racks of leather jackets and fringed skirts, a display table of cowboy hats and a row of leather boots below. Choose an outfit before heading to the arena.

cafe.title: Bách Mã Saloon Café
cafe.subtitle: Saloon-style café
cafe.text: A two-storey café with a timber balcony and large windows facing the yard. Inside, a dark wooden bar, round tables and a mezzanine make a place to rest with a coconut coffee after riding.

horseClass.title: Horse Basics Class
horseClass.subtitle: Beginner riding lesson
horseClass.text: A covered learning arena with low timber rails and a safe sand floor, where a trainer works one-to-one on approaching, grooming and leading a horse.

lasso.title: Lasso & Horseshoe Corner
lasso.subtitle: Horseshoes and lasso corner
lasso.text: The lane between the stable block and the covered arena, with horseshoe emblems on the timber wall and a cross-braced fence in the distance.

stables.title: Stables
stables.subtitle: Horse stables
stables.text: An indoor stable row with skylights, white timber railings and a wide aisle; every horse has its own stall, with tack hung within easy reach.

ridingRing.title: Riding Ring
ridingRing.subtitle: The riding arena
ridingRing.text: A broad sand arena with a timber fence and a steel-arched roof behind it, looking out to the distant mountains. Where riders train in the Cổ Cò sun.

video.title: Two Minutes Nineteen Seconds Around Bách Mã Viên
video.description: A pre-rendered walkthrough from the main entrance to the riding ring, stopping at each point along Cowboy Town. Tap a chapter to jump straight to the part you want to see.

cta.text: Choose your tickets and book today.
